from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperInfo(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection, capturing its title and which other papers in the collection it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    cites_in_collection: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that this paper explicitly cites in its bibliography")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the bibliography confirming the relationship")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperInfo]
